_comment: MCP servers for this repo. HTTP-ONLY BY POLICY (2026-08-23) — no 'command' (stdio) entries.
WHY: an agent host spawns the full stdio server set once per session AND per subagent, and
codex's app-server does not reap them when a session ends. Measured 2026-08-23: 2365 leaked
processes holding 53 GB of 58 GB RAM, 97% of them with <=1s cumulative CPU (spawned, never
used, never freed). Cost scales as (stdio servers) x (sessions ever run), so a stdio entry is
a standing leak, not a fixed cost. A 'url' entry spawns nothing locally.
TO ADD A CAPABILITY, in order: (1) hosted endpoint as 'url' here; (2) an Agent Skill that
shells out per call, the way cocoindex is handled (repo-search script + skill); (3) resident
stdio only with a written justification and a reaping story. Nothing has needed (3) yet.
REMOVED: fetch (uvx mcp-server-fetch) -- exa's web_fetch_exa covers it; for localhost/intranet
URLs exa cannot reach, use `curl -sL "$URL" | pandoc -f html -t markdown`.
